headline.purpose: Section statements and mobile page titles.

metadata.purpose: Compact result summaries and supporting data.

label.purpose: Navigation, genres, fields, steps, and compact actions.

shadows.name: consent-lift
shadows.purpose: Separates the fixed media-consent decision from page content.

components.name: Primary CTA
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 20px; background: var(--cta-bg, #0a0a0a); color: var(--cta-text, #f8f8f8); font: 600 12px/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color .2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--cta-hover, #333); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text-60, #666); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline CTA
components.description: Secondary action with a structural one-pixel rule.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d0d0d0); border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 20px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-60, #555); font: 600 12px/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: border-color .2s ease, color .2s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover, .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { border-color: var(--text, #0a0a0a); color: var(--text, #0a0a0a); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text-60, #666); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Discovery Style Control
components.description: Neutral selection status with a quiet inline reset above equal-sized musical-style selectors.
components.html: 1 OF 5 STYLES SELECTED
components.css: .ds-style-filter header { display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; color: #8a8a8a; font: 700 12px/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-style-filter > div { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-style-choice { min-width: 168px; min-height: 44px; flex: 0 1 calc((100% - 16px) / 3); border: 1px solid #333; border-radius: 0; padding: 10px 14px; background: transparent; color: #999; font: 800 11px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-style-choice[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--style-color, #65a2ff) 68%, var(--text, #0a0a0a)); background: var(--control-surface, #f0f0f0); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--style-color, #65a2ff) 68%, var(--text, #0a0a0a)); color: var(--text, #0a0a0a); } .ds-style-choice i { display: inline-block; width: 9px; height: 9px; margin-right: 10px; background: var(--style-color, #65a2ff); } .ds-style-choice:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text, #f8f8f8); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-reset { min-height: 44px; border: 0; padding: 8px 0; background: transparent; color: #999; font: 700 11px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-reset:hover, .ds-reset:focus-visible { color: var(--text, #f8f8f8); } .ds-reset:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text, #f8f8f8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Summary and Reset
components.description: Compact Grid result summary paired with the global reset at the end of the filter panel.
components.css: .ds-filter-footer { display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, #d0d0d0); padding: 0 16px; color: var(--text-60, #666); font: 600 14px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-filter-footer strong { color: var(--text, #0a0a0a); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 700; } .ds-reset { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text-60, #666); font: 700 11px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color .18s ease; } .ds-reset:hover, .ds-reset:focus-visible { color: var(--text, #0a0a0a); } .ds-reset:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text, #0a0a0a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Artist Card Accent
components.description: Image-led artist card with a one-pixel style signal beneath the photograph.
components.css: .ds-artist-card { position: relative; width: 280px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a2a2a); border-radius: 0; background: #0a0a0a; color: #f8f8f8; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-artist-card div { height: 180px; border-bottom: 1px solid #65a2ff; background: #141414; } .ds-artist-card strong { display: block; padding: 16px; font-size: 18px; } .ds-artist-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--text, #f8f8f8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square, full-width booking field with a quiet tonal surface.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; color: var(--text-60, #555); font: 600 12px/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-field input { min-height: 50px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d0d0d0); border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 16px; background: var(--surface, #e8e8e8); color: var(--text, #0a0a0a); font: 400 16px/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: normal; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text-60, #666); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Tracked uppercase link with an underline sweep.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-block; color: var(--text-60, #555); font: 500 14px/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-decoration: none; transition: color .3s ease, transform .3s ease; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: -4px; left: 0; height: 1px; background: var(--text-20, #bbb); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform .3s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--text, #0a0a0a); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text-60, #666); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: Flat square container using tone and a thin structural border.
components.html:
BOOKINGS

Find the right artist.

Tell us the sound and event you are planning.
components.css: .ds-card { max-width: 320px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d0d0d0); border-radius: 0; padding: 24px; background: var(--bg-subtle, #f0f0f0); color: var(--text, #0a0a0a); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card span { color: var(--text-30, #777); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .4em; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 12px 0; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-60, #555); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.625; } .ds-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--text-60, #666); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Booking Section
components.description: Bordered collapsible section with a tonal control header.
components.css: .ds-booking-section { border: 1px solid var(--border, #d0d0d0); border-radius: 0; color: var(--text, #0a0a0a); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-booking-section button { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; border: 0; padding: 16px 20px; background: var(--surface, #e8e8e8); color: var(--text-60, #555); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .1em; text-align: left; } .ds-booking-section b { margin-right: 12px; color: var(--text-30, #777); font-size: 12px; } .ds-booking-section i { font-size: 20px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400; } .ds-booking-section > div { border-top: 1px solid var(--border, #d0d0d0); padding: 24px; font-size: 14px; } .ds-booking-section button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text-60, #666); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Media Consent Banner
components.description: Theme-inverted fixed decision surface with restrained overlay depth.
components.html: Choose whether to load third-party music players.
components.css: .ds-consent { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--media-banner-border, #777); padding: 16px 24px; background: var(--media-banner-bg, #0a0a0a); color: var(--media-banner-text, #f8f8f8); box-shadow: 0 -10px 30px var(--media-banner-shadow, rgba(0,0,0,.24)); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-consent p { margin: 0; color: var(--media-banner-muted, #ccc); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.625; } .ds-consent div { display: flex; gap: 12px; } .ds-consent button { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--media-banner-border, #777); border-radius: 0; padding: 0 20px; background: transparent; color: var(--media-banner-muted, #ccc); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-consent .ds-consent-accept { background: var(--media-banner-action-bg, #f8f8f8); color: var(--media-banner-action-text, #0a0a0a); } .ds-consent button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--media-banner-text, #f8f8f8); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
AAA Artists uses a monochrome structural system with a controlled spectral signal for artist discovery. The identity is precise, restrained, confident, underground, and useful: editorial hierarchy and deliberate spacing carry more weight than decoration. It should feel connected to a serious promoter and artist agency, never like a generic marketplace.

The logo, black-and-white product chrome, and equal light/dark themes remain the anchors. Color is functional rather than decorative: cool hues identify Trance styles, warm hues identify Techno styles, and BPM remains encoded by position. Corporate software styling, uncontrolled festival graphics, and luxury-agency ornament are anti-references.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome product chrome led by the AAA Artists logo.
A stable cool-to-warm spectrum identifies musical styles across themes.
Square geometry, thin rules, and tonal surfaces.
Bold headlines paired with compact uppercase labels.
Artist imagery and audio provide the expressive content.

rules.name: The Theme Parity Rule
rules.body: Light and dark are equal products. Neither may be treated as an afterthought or simple colour inversion.

rules.name: The Spectral Signal Rule
rules.body: Product chrome remains black, white, and grey. The discovery spectrum is the one systematic color layer, and its hues remain identical in both themes.

rules.name: The One Typeface Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from disciplined scale, weight, and spacing; do not introduce a decorative display face without an explicit identity decision.

rules.name: The Proximity Before Boxes Rule
rules.body: Use spacing to establish related groups before adding another bordered container. A border must communicate a real structural boundary or state.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Persistent surfaces use borders and tone. Shadow communicates temporary overlay depth, not decoration.

rules.name: The Square Instrument Rule
rules.body: Booking controls, CTAs, navigation controls, and content containers remain square unless the function itself calls for a circle.

dos: Do preserve the logo as a black-and-white identity anchor in both themes.
Do refine the monochrome-led system through hierarchy, spacing, imagery, and interaction craft.
Do use the fixed cool Trance and warm Techno spectrum only to identify musical styles.
Do verify every visual change in light and dark, on mobile and desktop.
Do use artist media and audio as the expressive layer while interface chrome stays restrained.
Do keep interaction, keyboard focus, and touch state visible.
donts: Don't replace the incumbent identity when the task asks for refinement.
Don't use spectral colors decoratively or change their hues between light and dark themes.
Don't imitate a corporate dashboard, colourful festival campaign, or luxury-agency aesthetic.
Don't round every surface or use shadows to make ordinary containers feel important.
Don't create extra bordered cards when proximity can express the relationship.
